title: Bhoop Singh v. State of U.P. and Others
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: Vivek Kumar Birla and Nand Prabha Shukla, JJ.
disposition: Writ disposed with liberty to file a fresh clause 6.5 representation within ten days, to be decided in accordance with law.
headnote: Recovery citation for electricity dues of Rs.10,11,565 — correctness disputed — writ disposed with liberty to file a fresh representation under clause 6.5 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005 within ten days, to be decided by the authority concerned in accordance with law.
facts: Bhoop Singh challenged a recovery citation dated 31 July 2023 issued by the Tehsildar, Tehsil Sarila, District Hamirpur, for electricity dues of Rs.10,11,565 plus other charges, and asked that respondents 3 and 4 decide a representation he said was already on file. The Court stayed coercive steps on the citation while the Electricity Department took instructions. On 12 December 2024 the Power Corporation produced documents and maintained that the amount shown was correct. The petitioner disputed that figure and said he had already approached the concerned authority.

holding_units.topic: disputed recovery citation — fresh clause 6.5 representation
holding_units.holding: Where the consumer disputes the correctness of electricity dues under a recovery citation, the writ is disposed of with liberty to file a fresh representation before the authority concerned under clause 6.5 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005, within ten days, together with a certified copy of the order. That authority shall consider and decide the representation in accordance with law under clause 6.5. The Court does not itself determine the dues, even where the petitioner states that he has already approached the authority.

principle_tags.application: The writ seeking quashing of the recovery citation was disposed of because clause 6.5 was treated as the remedy, with liberty to file a fresh representation within ten days rather than the Court deciding the demand.
The Power Corporation asserted that Rs.10,11,565 as reflected was correct and the petitioner disputed it; that dispute over the recovery citation was left to a fresh representation under clause 6.5.

not_decided.point: Whether the recovery citation dated 31.07.2023 for Rs.10,11,565 and other charges was correct
not_decided.note: Left to the authority concerned on a fresh representation under clause 6.5, to be decided in accordance with law.
